purpose: Broad, source-first orthogonal alpha discovery inventory from public/free data channels.

candidates.name: Settlement-pressure divergence
candidates.next_gate: publication timing, security mapping, synthetic PIT
candidates.hypothesis: A fixed disagreement state between short-sale flow intensity and lagged outstanding FTD balance may contain information distinct from either input alone.
candidates.construction: Fixed state comparing normalized FINRA daily short-sale flow with lagged SEC FTD outstanding balance; use only source observations available by the decision boundary, freeze security mapping, and align to the next eligible session.

candidates.name: Short-interest stock-vs-flow disagreement
candidates.hypothesis: The disagreement between short-interest position snapshots and short-sale flow may define a distinct information state.
candidates.construction: Fixed categorical state for high-flow/low-stock, low-flow/high-stock and aligned cases using the separately published FINRA products; observation dates and security mapping are frozen and no venue-completeness approximation is introduced.

candidates.name: Innovation confirmation gap
candidates.hypothesis: Relative timing between public patent events and open-market insider purchases may define a distinct innovation-confirmation information state.
candidates.construction: Fixed relative-timing state between USPTO application/publication/grant events and SEC Form 4 open-market purchases; SEC acceptance time anchors public information, transaction-code inclusion is frozen, and patent event dates remain distinct.

candidates.name: Patent novelty × public attention
candidates.hypothesis: Backward-looking patent novelty combined with public attention may define an information state distinct from either component alone.
candidates.construction: Fixed backward-only patent-novelty proxy combined with Wikimedia pageview surprise; forward citations and later metadata cannot alter an earlier state, entity mapping is frozen, and attention is observed only after the public event boundary.

candidates.name: Disclosure-processing congestion
candidates.hypothesis: Issuer filing-density congestion may represent an information-processing state distinct from filing identity alone.
candidates.construction: Fixed rolling filing-density state from SEC acceptance timestamps and filing categories before each decision point; amendments and duplicate accessions remain separate, with no return-based threshold selection.

candidates.name: Fund-crowding shock
candidates.next_gate: fixed-quarter accession lineage and bounded processing
candidates.hypothesis: Overlap or concentration across public fund positions may define a portfolio-network information state beyond one-manager transitions.
candidates.construction: Fixed fund-ownership overlap/concentration state from SEC N-PORT and 13F public filings; accession lineage, security mapping and dissemination cutoffs are frozen, and no portfolio weighting search is permitted.

candidates.name: Treasury-demand × equity rate-sensitivity
candidates.next_gate: financial-field freeze and auction publication clock
candidates.hypothesis: Issuer financing sensitivity interacting with Treasury auction demand may define a cross-market information state.
candidates.construction: Fixed issuer financing-sensitivity descriptor from PIT-valid SEC/XBRL facts interacted with fixed Treasury auction-demand states; concept lineage and auction publication time are preserved without threshold optimization.

candidates.name: CFTC positioning × commodity-exposure regime
candidates.next_gate: release-date PIT and fixed exposure mapping
candidates.hypothesis: CFTC positioning combined with a fixed commodity-exposure regime may define an information state distinct from equity prices alone.
candidates.construction: Fixed CFTC positioning state using release time, interacted with a lagged, pre-frozen issuer/industry commodity-exposure descriptor; report date is never substituted for public release date.

candidates.name: Institutional calendar collision × liquidity
candidates.hypothesis: Coincident scheduled institutional-demand events combined with liquidity may define a deterministic calendar-collision state.
candidates.construction: Fixed count of pre-scheduled index, ETF, futures, options and rebalance/roll events coinciding with a fixed liquidity state; historical calendars are reconstructed without using later membership announcements or returns.

candidates.name: Supply-chain macro shock exposure
candidates.hypothesis: Macro shocks weighted through a fixed industry input-output network may define heterogeneous supply-chain information states.
candidates.construction: Fixed industry exposure matrix from BEA Input-Output tables multiplied by the macro state from the correct FRED/ALFRED real-time vintage; revisions and classification concordance are frozen before any evaluation.

candidates.name: Public OSS release externality
candidates.next_gate: stable event registration and peer-map provenance
candidates.hypothesis: Material public software releases may transmit ecosystem information to pre-registered complements or competitors independently of price history.
candidates.construction: Fixed event set of public GitHub releases mapped through a pre-registered ecosystem graph; event visibility and publication metadata are used as observed, while meaningful-release classification is frozen ex ante and never tuned on returns.

candidates.name: Attention-response gap
candidates.hypothesis: Abnormal public attention following an issuer disclosure may define a distinct information-response state.
candidates.construction: Fixed post-filing Wikimedia pageview-surprise state linked to SEC filing acceptance; entity mapping and measurement latency are frozen, and the response window remains next-session unless a stronger timestamp contract is proven.

candidates.name: Cross-asset policy state
candidates.hypothesis: Unusual Treasury demand combined with unusual CFTC positioning and macro-vintage state may define a cross-asset policy information state.
candidates.construction: Fixed state machine combining independently timestamped Treasury, CFTC and FRED/ALFRED states; mixed-frequency alignment follows each source's public release/vintage boundary and no collision window is optimized.
